releaseNotes:
• Multi-item carousels: Extract all 15+ items instantly via direct Vue state and API interception
• Lightning-fast History & Archive: Instant <50ms load with background MediaStore reconciliation
• Universal cover thumbnails: All posts and deleted archive items show fast persistent cover previews
• Modern In-App OTA Update: Seamless in-app download and one-tap installer with progress bar
• In-App Diagnostic Logs: Export, copy, and share live logs without requiring USB debugging
• Clean Commercial Settings: Dynamic version binding (v1.1.2 Build 4) and polished experience
